1.w: For the music director, a psalm of David. The heavens declare the glory of God; the sky displays his handiwork.

2.w: Day after day it speaks out; night after night it reveals his greatness.

3.w: There is no actual speech or word, nor is its voice literally heard.

4.w: Yet its voice echoes throughout the earth; its words carry to the distant horizon. In the sky he has pitched a tent for the sun.

5.w: Like a bridegroom it emerges from its chamber; like a strong man it enjoys running its course.

6.w: It emerges from the distant horizon, and goes from one end of the sky to the other; nothing can escape its heat.

7.w: The law of the Lord is perfect and preserves one’s life. The rules set down by the Lord are reliable and impart wisdom to the inexperienced.

8.w: The Lord ’s precepts are fair and make one joyful. The Lord ’s commands are pure and give insight for life.

9.w: The commands to fear the Lord are right and endure forever. The judgments given by the Lord are trustworthy and absolutely just.

10.w: They are of greater value than gold, than even a great amount of pure gold; they bring greater delight than honey, than even the sweetest honey from a honeycomb.

11.w: Yes, your servant finds moral guidance there; those who obey them receive a rich reward.

12.w: Who can know all his errors? Please do not punish me for sins I am unaware of.

13.w: Moreover, keep me from committing flagrant sins; do not allow such sins to control me. Then I will be blameless and innocent of blatant rebellion.

14.w: May my words and my thoughts be acceptable in your sight, O Lord , my sheltering rock and my redeemer.
